notes.subject: ברכת
notes.rationale: ברכת i min 'yu givim blessing', tasol ol tanim tok i putim 'blaspheme/curs' — euphemism bilong Hibru; ylt i holim 'bless'

notes.subject: בני בליעל
notes.rationale: 'pikinini bilong nating' — Belial i no nem bilong man hia, em i tok bilong 'ol man nating olgeta'

notes.subject: ויעדהו
notes.rationale: Hibru i gat 'ol i ken tanim tok gen gen' ( testify bilong tupela man) — Tok Pisin i lossim wankain mak bilong toktok gen

translation: Na ol i ken sevatupela man, tupela pikinini bilong nating, long fes bilong em, na tupela i ken givim tok against long em, i tok olsem: Yu bagarapim nem bilong Elohim na bilong king. Na ol i ken kukim em i go ausait, na ol i ken stonim em, na em bai i dai.

tokens.gloss: i ken givim tok against long em
ol i ken kukim em i go ausait
